name: jev-guardrails
description: Jev-backed guardrails and verification for LLM apps, plus a thin DeepSeek Harness plugin.

scripts.test:lib: npm run build --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails && npm run test --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails
scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codebam/dsh-jev-guardrails && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codebam/eval-jev-guardrails
